page.notes: Part 1 of 2; the text continues below the cut. Some letters in the italic lines are worn and uncertain, e.g. "Paulus", "Apollo", "dedit", "dominus" are read as printed but may be imperfect. The line "per quae deus operatur" has the word "quae" printed as "quæ". Text is partly illegible in the scan (blurred right and left edges); the catchword line "rium" is read from fragments. Words such as "fundamentum" and "ponere" were read with some uncertainty and are not marked with [?] because the scan is clear enough at those points.
